description: Deep-dive for tuning and release comparison: per-stage worker latency, throughput (RTF), prefix-cache effectiveness, and per-config/version tables. Filter by model/engine/device. For caller-felt latency use Voice Agent KPIs; for one call use Session Detail.

panels.title: LLM — the stage that gates first audio

panels.description: Time-to-first-token p95 — the LLM latency that actually gates the caller's first audio (not the full reply).

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: LLM TTFT p95

panels.description: Full-reply decode p95. This runs while the caller is already hearing the reply, so it's throughput, not felt latency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(decode_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: LLM decode p95

panels.description: Admission queue wait p95. Rising queue means the LLM is saturated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(queue_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: LLM queue p95

panels.description: Decode throughput — output tokens per second (average).

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(decode_tokens_per_second) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: Decode tokens/sec

panels.description: Independent p95s of the LLM's own signals over time — queue, prompt build, TTFT, decode. These are separate measurements, not additive stages.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(toDateTime(intDiv(event_time_ms,1000))) AS time, quantile(0.95)(queue_ms) AS queue_ms, quantile(0.95)(prompt_build_ms) AS prompt_build_ms, quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms) AS ttft_ms, quantile(0.95)(decode_ms) AS decode_ms FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: LLM latency signals — independent p95s

panels.description: Per config/version: volume, success rate, and the LLM p95s. Sort by ttft to find the config that gates first audio the worst.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pipeline_version, model, engine, device, gpu_uuid, count() AS calls, round(countIf(status='ok')/nullIf(count(),0)*100,2) AS success_pct, round(quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms),0) AS ttft_p95_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(decode_ms),0) AS decode_p95_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(queue_ms),0) AS queue_p95_ms, round(avg(decode_tokens_per_second),1) AS avg_tok_s, round(avg(input_tokens),0) AS avg_in_tok, round(avg(output_tokens),0) AS avg_out_tok FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY pipeline_version, model, engine, device, gpu_uuid ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: LLM by config / release

panels.description: The slowest individual LLM calls (full reply). Copy a session_id into Session Detail for the full trace.

targets.rawSql: SELECT session_id, turn_id, model, engine, device, round(duration_ms,0) AS reply_ms, round(ttft_ms,0) AS ttft_ms, round(decode_ms,0) AS decode_ms, round(queue_ms,0) AS queue_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, error_class FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) ORDER BY reply_ms DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Worst LLM calls
LLM prefix cache — is the shared system prompt / history staying warm?

panels.description: Token-weighted: of all prompt tokens sent, the fraction the engine served from cache. Higher = cheaper prefill.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100*sum(cached_prompt_tokens)/nullIf(sum(input_tokens),0) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND cached_prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: Prefix-cache hit rate (token-weighted)

panels.description: Fraction of LLM calls that got ANY prefix-cache hit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100*countIf(prefix_cache_hit)/nullIf(count(),0) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND cached_prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: Requests with a cache hit

panels.description: TTFT p95 split by whether the prompt hit the prefix cache. The gap is the concrete latency the cache buys you.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(toDateTime(intDiv(event_time_ms,1000))) AS time, quantileIf(0.95)(ttft_ms, prefix_cache_hit=1) AS hit_ttft_p95, quantileIf(0.95)(ttft_ms, prefix_cache_hit=0) AS miss_ttft_p95 FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND cached_prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: TTFT p95 — cache hits vs misses
STT — throughput & padding (capacity, not felt latency)

panels.description: Segment real-time factor p95 — compute seconds per audio second. < 1 means faster than real time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(realtime_factor) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='stt.segment_profile' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: STT segment RTF p95

panels.description: Fraction of transcribed audio that was silence padding (bounds tensor shapes). High = wasted compute.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(padded_seconds/nullIf(audio_seconds+padded_seconds,0)) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='stt.segment_profile' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: STT padding fraction

panels.description: STT worker signal p95s over time — queue, encode, decode, compute.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(toDateTime(intDiv(event_time_ms,1000))) AS time, quantile(0.95)(queue_ms) AS queue_ms, quantile(0.95)(encode_ms) AS encode_ms, quantile(0.95)(decode_ms) AS decode_ms, quantile(0.95)(compute_ms) AS compute_ms FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='stt.segment_profile' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: STT worker signals — segment p95s

targets.rawSql: SELECT pipeline_version, model, engine, device, gpu_uuid, count() AS segments, round(quantile(0.95)(compute_ms),0) AS compute_p95_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(realtime_factor),3) AS rtf_p95, round(avg(audio_seconds),2) AS avg_audio_s, round(avg(padded_seconds/nullIf(audio_seconds+padded_seconds,0)),3) AS padding_fraction FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='stt.segment_profile' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY pipeline_version, model, engine, device, gpu_uuid ORDER BY segments DESC

panels.title: TTS — throughput & real-time factor (capacity, not first-audio latency)

panels.description: Reply real-time factor p95 — synth seconds per audio second. < 1 means TTS renders faster than playback (streaming keeps up).

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(realtime_factor) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: TTS RTF p95

panels.description: Total synthesis compute p95 per reply (sum across the reply's sentences).

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(service_proc_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: TTS synth compute p95

panels.description: TTS reply signals over time — synth compute p95, RTF p95, request volume.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(toDateTime(intDiv(event_time_ms,1000))) AS time, quantile(0.95)(service_proc_ms) AS synth_p95_ms, quantile(0.95)(realtime_factor) AS rtf_p95, count() AS requests FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: TTS reply signals — p95s

targets.rawSql: SELECT pipeline_version, model, engine, device, gpu_uuid, count() AS replies, round(quantile(0.95)(service_proc_ms),0) AS synth_p95_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(realtime_factor),3) AS rtf_p95, round(quantile(0.95)(audio_seconds),2) AS audio_p95_s FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY pipeline_version, model, engine, device, gpu_uuid ORDER BY replies DESC

list.label: Model
list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE model != '' ORDER BY model

list.label: Engine
list.name: engine
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT engine FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE engine != '' ORDER BY engine

list.label: Device
list.name: device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE device != '' ORDER BY device
